e-4387.knowledge_point: Finding the Transpose of a Row Vector or Column Vector
e-4387.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns. 

Here, there is just a single row, so it becomes a single column:

$$
{A}^T = 
    		\left\lbrack
    		\matrix {
    5 \ 
    -1 \ 
    0 \  
    		}
    		\right\rbrack
$$
